headline: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
summary: OpenAI commits to not using NDAs with public officials for data center projects. Decision follows strong voter opposition to data center expansion in midterms. Many data center projects have faced scrutiny for hiding discussions with NDAs.

headline: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent
summary: Airbnb plans to launch an AI travel agent in the first half of 2027. The AI will assist users with planning and booking travel. Company acknowledges current AI agents excel at simple, routine tasks.

headline: The New York Times is in talks to buy Letterboxd for around $330 million
summary: The New York Times Company is in exclusive talks to acquire Letterboxd. The social network for film lovers is valued around $330 million. Other interested parties reportedly included Sony Pictures and A24.

headline: T-Mobile owner on Elon Musk launching a wireless carrier: ‘Welcome to the party’
summary: T-Mobile's parent company CEO casts doubt on Starlink Mobile becoming a major US carrier. Deutsche Telekom CEO Tim Hoettges takes Elon Musk's plan "super serious". He estimates the cost to establish such a network at "at least $200 billion".

headline: After Buying EA, Silver Lake and PIF Are Reportedly Now Seeking to Acquire Gaming Software Provider Unity
summary: Silver Lake and PIF, after acquiring EA, are reportedly targeting Unity. Unity is a major provider of gaming software and development tools. This potential acquisition signals further consolidation in the gaming industry.

headline: Save 50% Off the Wolfbox Cordless Car Jump Starter and 24,000mAh Power Bank Ahead of Black Friday
summary: Get 50% off the Wolfbox Cordless Car Jump Starter and Power Bank. The device features a 24,000mAh capacity. This Black Friday deal offers a significant discount for a crucial car accessory.

headline: Amazon's Black Friday Audible Deal Is Now Live: Pay $0.99 Per Month Plus Get $20 Credit
summary: Amazon's early Black Friday Audible deal is now live. Subscribers can get Audible for $0.99 per month and a $20 credit. The offer is available to all members, new or existing, Prime or non-Prime.

headline: Amazon Reveals Free Uber Eats Delivery for Prime Members, Plus $20 Off Your First Two Orders
summary: Amazon Prime members now get free Uber Eats delivery. Prime subscribers also receive $20 off their first two Uber Eats orders. This new perk enhances the value proposition for Amazon Prime.

headline: Did a data centre revolt affect the US mid-term election results?
summary: BBC Verify investigates if US voters were swayed by the data centre boom. Examines the potential impact of anti-AI sentiment on the industry. The inquiry suggests a link between voter opposition and mid-term outcomes.

headline: Met chief warns policing 'heading for failure' without reform
summary: Met Commissioner Sir Mark Rowley warns policing is "heading for failure". He argues the current system cannot cope with modern criminal sophistication. Rowley emphasizes the urgent need for significant reform within the force.

headline: 'Misleading' student loans information left out examples of higher-salary repayments
summary: Student loan information deemed "misleading" by Treasury Committee chair. Examples of higher-salary repayments were omitted from disclosures. One university controversially compared repayments to the cost of coffee.

headline: Watch: Met Police release Brand interview footage
summary: Met Police have released interview footage of Russell Brand. Brand was found guilty of one count of rape and three sexual assaults. The conviction was handed down at Southwark Crown Court.
